quarterly_data.signal: Data-center strategy, R&D & catalysts (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): DATA-CENTER BUSINESS was added to the corporate charter at the 2026-03-26 AGM as a 'core growth business' covering UHV equipment, switchgear/substations, transformers, power monitoring/control, xEMS energy management, DCIM and HVAC-optimisation solutions; 2025 data-center revenue ~KRW 546.8B; the filing cites IEA's 485TWh (2025) to ~950TWh (2030) data-center power forecast with AI data centers ~3x. Track record: multiple domestic data-center references; North American hyperscale switchgear & distribution-transformer contracts and AI data-center HV/LV switchgear & transformer contracts (2026-04: KRW 170.3B and KRW 319.0B North American data-center power-equipment projects); an AI-based data-center HVAC control pilot completed with subsidiary LS Sauter; plan to move from equipment supply to integrated power-cooling-operations data-center solutions and to keep winning North American hyperscale projects. R&D H1 2026 KRW 84,742M (2.9% of revenue); dedicated 'DC Square Solution' research teams at the Anyang and Cheongju R&D campuses; H1 results include an AWS-targeted 3-pole plug-in UL Susol MCCB 125AF, UL 38kV VCB Gen.2, LGES-targeted IMD1000U 1000V insulation monitor, high-capacity arc-resistant modular MDB/MCC, UHV transformer design program, HVDC valve design, MVDC, superconducting fault-current-limiter operation, AI diagnostics/protection, semiconductor circuit breaker and DC-grid patents (5,152 patents held). Corporate history lists the 2025-07 GE Vernova HVDC converter-valve localisation MOU, the KRW 100.8B Busan UHV-transformer expansion completed 10-2025, the KRW 459.8B North American IOU renewables UHV-transformer order (11-2025) and the 2026-02 Yeonggwang 90MW solar EPC/O&M (NTP 2026-06-05). Corporate: 5:1 split effective 2026-04-10; chairman Koo Ja-kyun re-elected CEO to 2029-03-26; Chae Dae-seok co-CEO; H1 TSR 159.3% (adjusted price KRW 92,000 to 238,000); monthly average share price rose from KRW 103,238 (Jan) to 276,694 (May), 235,595 (Jun); NPS holds 8.71%, LS Corp 48.46%. Risks: KFTC fine KRW 7,239M (01-24-2025) for KEPCO 170kV GIS bid-rigging 2015-2022, with a KEPCO 6-month bid ban (07-18-2025) stayed by court pending the cancellation suit and a criminal antitrust trial ongoing; LS Power Solution minority call option exercisable after Q2 2026 financials.
